description: OpenAI Agents SDK with one function tool, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch. OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor is constructed with replace_existing_processors, which clears the Agents SDK processor that exports to api.openai.com. The default client is pointed at the mock with use_for_tracing false. The capture keeps five spans: Agent Workflow, the weather agent, the response, the tool, and the second response. Token counts are copied from the Responses usage: input 82 then 131, output 17 then 12, cache_read 0 then 64, reasoning 0. Finish reasons are mapped from tool_calls to tool_call, then stop. The model is recorded as gen_ai.response.model.
